name: Toronto

neighborhoods.name: The Danforth
neighborhoods.homes: houses with upper and basement units

housing: Toronto renters live mainly in condo units rented from individual owners, older purpose-built rental towers, and rooms or basement apartments in houses.

localRules.text: Most residential tenancies in Ontario signed on or after April 30, 2018 must use the province's standard lease; a landlord may take a rent deposit but not a damage deposit.

tenantHelp.name: Advocacy Centre for Tenants Ontario (ACTO)
tenantHelp.what: free duty counsel for low-income tenants at the Landlord and Tenant Board

climate: Test the heating before winter and photograph windows and balcony doors; also check whether the unit has air conditioning, as Toronto summers are humid.
fact: Many Toronto rentals are condo units owned by individual investors, so the landlord is often not the building's manager.
